title: Diagnosing quantum reservoirs at scale based on expressivity and coverage
summary: Quantum reservoirs offer a hardware-friendly route to quantum machine learning, replacing trainable circuits with fixed random dynamics and a classical readout. Because the reservoir is not optimized, performance depends entirely on the choice of reservoir family, yet existing diagnostics demand resources that grow exponentially with system size. We introduce a scalable, hardware-agnostic framework built on two complementary quantities. The first is a task-independent order-statistics (ORS) expressivity score, which compares only the largest output probabilities of a reservoir ensemble…
